node.title: Re: How to pass a folder name to Windows external commands?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my @report = qx(robocopy /njh /nfl /ndl /np /l /s "$testpath" "x:\\nodir");

See my node [id://1180578]. In this case, I might recommend [mod://IPC::Run3], which on Windows uses [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] automatically.

Edits: Added mention of Win32::ShellQuote and quoted the node.
